journey_summary.claim: Round-2 hardening plan (same behavior + mechanism as round 1): faithful capture + M0 re-confirmation on the frozen feature set S; plan encodes all 6 rigor improvements + a pre-registered P1–P9 statistics protocol; 3 claims (C1 existence, C2 dose-response, C3 specificity), all swap-testable (MAX_VERIFY_CLAIMS=3).
journey_summary.mechanism_routing: family = SAE feature steering / feature amplification (Layer-26, blocks.26.post_norm), σ_proj-unit dosing; committed directly (Mode B)
journey_summary.experiment: All 3 claims supported. C1 (M0): frozen 19-feature set S re-confirmed 'established' — set-AUROC 0.89–0.90 prokaryote / 0.866 eukaryote-transfer vs confound-only ~0.50 and shuffle-null ~0.50; holds across 2 organisms and 2 helix definitions; no single feature clears 0.75 (set-level). C2: pLDDT-weighted helix (helix_hgi_w) rises monotonically with σ_proj-unit dose to an interior capability-preserved optimum c*=21.48 (valid-ORF 0.89); Spearman ρ=0.867 (ESMFold, p=0.0012) / 0.879 (OmegaFold, p=0.0008), dual-predictor agree. C3: at c* the helix gain is specific to S — Δ=+0.129 (ESMFold) / +0.135 (OmegaFold) with cluster-robust CIs excluding 0; 0 of 48 norm-matched random directions match S (z=5.3 / 5.8, empirical p=0.020); matched-control Δ negative; helix rise NOT a pLDDT artifact (S pLDDT lower than baseline); β-arm β_v2 did not clear bar → documented helix-axis specificity. Null-phase timeout bug caught+repaired mid-run (checkpointing added); ~8 GPU-h lost, zero scientific loss.
journey_summary.verify: All 3 claims PASS (robustness 1.00, integrity clean, Phase-2 + Phase-9 audits clean). Swap axis: DSSP helix-definition (HGI → H-only strict α-helix) — the genuine within-family 'model' swap (Evo2-7B+SAE fixed by definition; structure predictor already dual). C1 H-only AUROC 0.906/0.868 ≈ HGI 0.901/0.866; C2 H-only ρ=0.867/0.903 ≥ HGI; C3 H-only 0/48 null≥S, z=5.83/6.13 ≥ HGI z=5.30/5.80 — specificity strengthens under the swap. Analysis-only (0 GPU-h; reused pre-computed H-only readouts).

open_items: Predictor-mediated causality: all downstream causal claims (C2 dose-response, C3 specificity) depend on computational structure predictors (ESMFold, OmegaFold); paper title/abstract must avoid biological ground-truth-control language. Future round: add orthogonal sequence-level helix-propensity metrics (Chou-Fasman, PROSS) or MD-snapshot DSSP.

C1 label-provenance documentation: PDB redundancy filtering, homology-family split policy, codon-to-residue mapping details, unresolved-residue handling — currently in code only; must be documented explicitly in the paper's supplementary.

Capability preservation breadth: valid-ORF alone is thin. Future round: add Evo2 LM perplexity, amino-acid composition drift, repeat/low-complexity content, length/truncation distribution, codon usage drift, disorder-prediction summary.

C3 finite-null resolution: with n_null=48, empirical one-sided p is floored at ~1/(48+1)=0.0204. Both z-score (5.30/5.80) and empirical p must be reported together; if affordable, future round can add principled null families (matched sparse-feature sets, same-cardinality non-helix-enriched sets, activation-matched controls).

C3 H-only variant lacks cluster-bootstrap CI: per-sample H-only helix_h_w values not stored in M3 files. Future runs must persist per-sample values for every swap endpoint. Does not affect verify verdict — empirical p and z-score remain valid.

C3 ESMFold hard-gated pLDDT-threshold sweep null: bin populations too thin at ESMFold's calibration for stable pLDDT-threshold readouts. OmegaFold gate-sweep is populated and stable; primary pLDDT-weighted endpoint unaffected.
Matched-control arm construction transparency: paper writeup must specify exactly how matched-control features were chosen and what statistics were matched to preempt cherry-picking accusations.
β-arm framing discipline: the supported claim is helix-axis specificity, NOT symmetric helix-vs-sheet disentanglement. Paper text must not drift back to 'secondary-structure axis' language.

Mechanistic depth: future work should probe where the 19 features fire in sequence, codon/amino-acid motifs enriched by steering, whether steering shifts amino-acid composition toward helix-favoring residues, and whether the effect is mediated by residue identity, periodicity, hydrophobic patterns, signal peptides, transmembrane helices, or coiled-coils. Rule out trivial biological confounds (membrane proteins, signal peptides, coiled-coils, low-complexity helical repeats).

claims.statement: In Evo2-7B's Layer-26 SAE, a set-level group of features selectively marks α-helix codons (re-confirmed on the frozen round-1 feature set S; cross-organism), beyond confounds and multiple-testing chance.
claims.origin: task.md round 2 — given behavior, M0-gated existence; reuses frozen S from rounds/round_1/.

data.source: Natural CDS with experimental PDB structures + real DSSP labels (round-1 caches under data/, reused at full scale); + β_v2 re-identification on the same caches.
data.used_n: planned: reuse round-1 caches (>=500k labeled codons, E. coli + H. sapiens); re-confirm frozen S

claims.method: Recompute per-codon set-level AUROC/F1 of frozen S vs DSSP helix labels from caches; confound + BH-FDR + shuffle-null re-confirmation; four-state M0 verdict; identify a stronger β-sheet set (β_v2).

main_experiment.key_stats: set-AUROC 0.887–0.901 (prokaryote/steer organism), 0.866 (eukaryote transfer) vs confound-only ~0.50–0.52 and shuffle-null ~0.50 (set_null_gap 0.37–0.48); frozen S=19 features; BH-FDR ~320–380 sig; best single-feature relaxed AUROC 0.62–0.68 (<0.75, set-level not single-feature); holds_multi_organism & holds_multi_helixdef True
main_experiment.headline: A frozen 19-feature Layer-26 set selectively marks α-helix codons at set-level AUROC ~0.86–0.90 (cross-organism, cross-helix-definition), far above confound/shuffle nulls — M0 verdict established.

claims.statement: Amplifying the α-helix feature set (σ_proj-unit dosing) during autoregressive DNA generation increases the encoded protein's pLDDT-weighted α-helix fraction, monotonically up to a mapped interior optimum, reproduced across two structure predictors.
claims.origin: task.md round 2 — given behavior, core causal claim, hardened.

data.source: Evo2-7B steered generation (σ_proj dosing) → ORF → ESMFold + second predictor → DSSP (mkdssp/pydssp) → pLDDT-weighted α-helix fraction.
data.used_n: planned ~>=300 valid-ORF/dose x 10 σ_proj doses x 2 predictors x 3 seeds = 60 runs

models: Evo2-7B + Layer-26 SAE steering hook (σ_proj units)
claims.method: σ_proj-unit dose-response; PRIMARY endpoint pLDDT-weighted helix fraction; split-sample c* selection (seed 42) → held-out trend (200,201); Spearman trend; pLDDT-threshold sweep + covariate conditioning; cluster-robust CIs; dual-predictor agreement.

main_experiment.key_stats: primary endpoint helix_hgi_w (pLDDT-weighted); σ_proj=0.410; interior c*=21.48 (valid-ORF 0.893 vs 0.88 baseline, capability preserved); ESMFold Spearman ρ=0.867 p=0.0012, OmegaFold ρ=0.879 p=0.0008; dual-predictor agree on trend sign; helix at c* ~0.454→0.593 (esm) / 0.473→0.612 (omega)
main_experiment.headline: Amplifying S monotonically raises the pLDDT-weighted α-helix fraction up to a demonstrated interior, capability-preserved optimum (c*=21.48 σ_proj-units); ρ~0.87–0.88 across two independent structure predictors.

iteration.final_reviewer_status: PASS (held) — brief consistency check clean; reviewer flagged monotonicity-language-scope and capability-metric-breadth as paper-side caveats

caveats: H-only Spearman ρ=0.867 (ESMFold)/0.903 (OmegaFold), p<0.001 both; Δ slightly larger under H-only.
Monotonicity language in the paper must be scoped to the pre-specified capability-preserved segment; the full curve is non-monotone under degradation (correctly excluded per plan P7).
Capability preservation metric (valid-ORF ≥ 0.95×baseline) is weakly specified for biological plausibility; future work should add composition drift, perplexity, disorder, length distribution.
Selection on 1 seed + evaluation on 2 seeds is acceptable but slightly thin.
Structure-predictor dependence remains the central paper-narrative vulnerability (two predictors is the strongest currently feasible without wet-lab/MD).

claims.statement: At the capability-preserved interior dose, the α-helix rise is specific to the feature set S — S's helix gain exceeds a >=30-direction norm-matched random-null (and matched-control) with a tight effect-size CI, reproduced across two predictors — establishing S as a causally manipulable, specific knob (helix-axis specificity; β-arm resolved).
claims.origin: task.md round 2 — given behavior, specificity/knob claim, hardened.

data.source: Steered generation at locked interior c* across feature kinds (S / matched-control / β_v2) + >=30-direction random null → ESMFold + 2nd predictor → DSSP (helix+sheet).

claims.method: S-vs->=30-direction norm-matched random-null (PRIMARY) at locked interior c* on held-out seeds; primary pLDDT-weighted endpoint at matched valid-ORF; empirical p + effect size with cluster-bootstrap CI; dual-predictor; β-arm: β_v2 raises sheet → double dissociation, else documented helix-axis specificity (P9).

main_experiment.key_stats: PRIMARY 48-direction norm-matched random null: S Δhelix_hgi_w +0.129 [0.100,0.159] (ESMFold) / +0.135 [0.109,0.161] (OmegaFold), cluster-robust CIs (283 clusters); 0/48 null dirs >= S under BOTH predictors (z=5.30 / 5.80, empirical one-sided p=0.020, null mean~0, null max 0.056–0.059); matched-control Δ NEGATIVE (-0.031 / -0.025); S valid-ORF 0.895 ~= null 0.882 ~= c0 0.902 (capability matched); S pLDDT (59.7/66.3) LOWER than baseline c0 (62.8/68.7) → helix gain not a pLDDT artifact; β_v2 did not clear bar
main_experiment.headline: At the clean interior dose the α-helix rise is specific to S: it exceeds every one of 48 norm-matched random directions (z~5.3–5.8) and the matched control, holds across two predictors, and is not a pLDDT-confidence artifact — S is a specific, causally manipulable knob (helix-axis specificity; β-arm a documented negative).

caveats: β-sheet amplification arm (β_v2) did not clear the sheet bar → C3 is helix-axis specificity, NOT a symmetric double dissociation (honest negative, per plan P9). Paper text must not slip back to symmetric-axis language.
ESMFold hard-gated pLDDT-threshold sweep returned null (OmegaFold gate-sweep populated and stable: S 0.65–0.67 vs c0 0.52–0.55 across pLDDT 50–80); primary pLDDT-weighted endpoint unaffected.

H-only 0/48 null >= S, z=5.83/6.13 (>= HGI z=5.30/5.80) — specificity strengthens under the swap. (Variant limitation: no cluster-bootstrap CI for H-only endpoint, per-sample H-only not stored; empirical p + z remain valid.)
Finite-null resolution: with n_null=48, empirical one-sided p is floored at ~1/(48+1)=0.0204. z-score (5.30 / 5.80) is much stronger than the p-value suggests; both must be reported together.
Matched-control arm construction must be transparent and audit-proof in the paper writeup (which statistics were matched, how features were selected) to preempt cherry-picking accusations.
